notes.title: Lust Academy Season 4 – Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Big News, Mages! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/9737fb5ecc2fd1548b46dd8e2a1de4990aac7df9.png

It’s time to mark your calendars because Lust Academy Season 4 officially launches on May 8! We've been working hard to make this the biggest and most exciting season yet, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

Why You Should Wishlist Now:
Wishlisting isn’t just a small button click—it’s a huge help for us as developers! The more wishlists we have, the better our chances of reaching more players and making Lust Academy even better. If you’re excited about Season 4, please add it to your wishlist today and ask your friends to do the same!

Still Haven’t Played the Demo?
You still have a chance to play the Season 4 Demo, but time is running out! The demo will disappear before launch, so now’s the perfect moment to dive in and get a taste of what’s coming.

Wishlist Now Play Demo

Thank you for your support—your wishlists mean the world to us!

notes.title: Official Release: Dive into the Sensual World of Lust Academy Season 3!
notes.notes:
Calling all true magic enthusiasts and adventure seekers! We're thrilled to announce the release of Lust Academy Season 3, an adventure that promises a full-body, uncompromising journey into the realm of passion and mystery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/c2f5eb8f29a6cb73cea0082bf79d3f7dc8c5549d.png
"Lust Academy - 3" is not just a sequel; it's a whole new chapter in the Lust Academy saga, packed with fresh storylines and beloved characters. Get ready for more feels, more believability, and of course, more passion than ever before!

Embark on an unforgettable adventure and experience the magic for yourself. 

Grab your copy now and immerse yourself in the tantalizing world of Lust Academy Season 3. 🌟

notes.title: Season 3. Final Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.notes:
Well, hello there!

Looks like you've stumbled across our weekly DevUpdate, and here's the joke of the week:
How do mermaids call their friends?
...
 On their "shell"-phones!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/cefa6eed11fd5ec6c97e87d240295cb0590c295c.png

Here's the list of what we've done in the previous week:

 Finished all remaning renders for Lust Academy season 3.
 Retouched all remaning renders for Lust Academy season 3.
 Finished all remaning animations for Lust Academy season 3.
 Finished updating skins for BIO.
 Finished working on the save file transfer function for season 4.
 Finished planning storylines for Season 4.
 Finished sound design for Season 3.

As you can see, Lust Academy season 3 is almost finished and heading to its steam release, while we're already in preparation for Season 4. That's it for today!

One more: let us remind you about a chance to win Steam gift cards.

To participate, add Lust Academy Season 3 to your wishlist 🙏 and click the celebration emoji "🎉" in our Discord channel. 

 15 ones will receive $10 Steam Gift cards each. 
We aim to hit +5,000 new wishlists since the start of the contest for Season 3, and once we achieve that, we're upping the ante! We'll throw two extra $100 gift cards into the prize pool! Let's make it a reality 🌟
  
Just hit that participate button, and our trusty bot will randomly pick a winner. 
And remember, the more friends you invite to join and wishlist, the closer we get to that ultimate prize!

notes.title: Lust Academy Season 3 Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/cf1a31773c7b725be1bafca50ac7f939eaca5a7e.png
We are happy to announce that our beloved game's highly anticipated Season 3 is just around the corner — it will launch in the next month!

The journey to this moment has been a labor of love. We've been working super hard on this, listening closely to your feedback every step of the way. 

As we get closer to the big day, we'd love your continued support. Tell your friends and fellow gamers about the game, and make sure to add it to your Steam wishlist.

Your enthusiasm fuels our passion, and we can't wait to share this new page of our adventure with you.

Keep an eye on our Discord for more updates and sneak peeks as launch day approaches. 

Get ready for a fantastic adventure in Season 3!

Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team.
